script:
[serious] Aapka sabse bada dushman kaun hai? 

[pause] 

Koi bahar ka insaan nahi. Aapka apna dimaag. Jo aapko har mushkil kaam se bachaata hai. Jo aapko comfortable zone mein rakhna chahta hai. Aaj Bookwala Safar par hum ek aisi kitani par baat karenge jo aapke is dimaag ke saare bahane hamesha ke liye khatam kar degi. Kitab ka naam hai, Can't Hurt Me, jise likha hai David Goggins ne. Goggins ko duniya ka sabse tough insaan kaha jata hai. Wo ek Navy SEAL hain, Army Ranger hain, aur unhone kayi ultra-marathons aur world records apne naam kiye hain. 

Lekin wo humesha aise nahi the. Ek waqt tha jab unka wazan lagbhag ek sau tis kilo tha. Wo daldal mein phanse hue the, unka bachpan gharelu hinsa aur darr se bhara tha, aur unke paas koi future nahi tha. Phir unhone apne dimaag ko badla. Unhone us sach ka samna kiya jise hum sab chhupate hain. 

[measured] Is video ko dhyan se suniye. Yeh koi aam motivational speech nahi hai. Yeh ek disciplined mind ka blueprint hai. Agar aap agle kuch minutes tak apna pura focus yahan rakh sakte hain, toh aap seekhenge ki kaise dimaag ki deewaron ko todkar apni maximum capacity tak pahuncha jata hai. Kyunki jab tak aap apne comfort zone se bahar nahi nikalte, aap sirf jee rahe hain, survive kar rahe hain, grow nahi kar rahe. 

Chaliye, is safar ki shuruaat karte hain ek aise aayine se, jo jhoot nahi bolta.

[authoritative] Hamara pehla bada lesson hai: The Accountability Mirror. 

David Goggins jab bade ho rahe then, toh unke paas hazar bahane the. Unke pita unpar aur unki maa par behad hinsa karte the. Unhe school mein theek se padhna nahi aata tya, unhe darr lagta tha, aur unka self-esteem bilkul zero tha. Ek din, unhone aayine mein dekha aur faisla kiya ki ab bahut ho gaya. Unhone ek naya tareeqa nikala jise wo Accountability Mirror kehte hain. 

Aapko kya lagta hai, aayina kya karta hai? Aayina aapko wahi dikhata hai jo sach hai. Wo filter nahi lagata. Wo aapke dimaag ke bahane nahi sunta. 

Goggins ne apne aayine par sticky notes lagana shuru kiya. Un sticky notes par unhone apne aane wale kal ke goals nahi likhe. Unhone un par apna sach likha. Jo sach unhe chubhata tha. Agar wo mote the, toh unhone likha, "Tum mote ho, tum lazy ho." Agar wo kisi exam mein fail ho rahe the, toh unhone likha, "Tumne mehnat nahi ki, tum darr gaye." 

[instructive] Yeh sunne mein shayad harsh lage. Lekin self-improvement ki pehli shart hai absolute honesty. Jab tak aap khud se jhoot bolte rahenge ki "Aaj thoda thak gaya tha isliye kaam nahi kiya" ya "Kal se pakka padhunga", tab tak aap wahin khade rahenge jahan aaj hain. Hum sab apne dosto se, apne parivar se sach bolne ki umeed karte hain, lekin khud se roz jhoot bolte hain. 

Accountability Mirror ka niyam seedha hai. Roz subah aayine ke samne khade hoiye. Apne aap ko aankhon mein dekhiye. Aur khud se puchiye, "Kya maine kal apna hundred percent diya?" Agar jawab 'nahi' hai, toh khud ko blame kijiye, halaat ko nahi. Apne dimaag ko bataiye ki aapne kahan galti ki. 

Goggins kehte hain ki jab aap apni kamiyon ko accept kar lete hain, tab un kamiyon ki taqat aap par se khatam ho jati hai. Agar aap khud ko keh dete hain ki "Haan, main is cheez mein kamzor hoon aur mujhe ispar kaam karna hai", toh koi dusra insaan aapko us baat ke liye hurt nahi kar sakta. Yeh aapki mental toughness ki pehli seedhi hai. Apne sach ko face kijiye, chahe wo kitna bhi dardnak kyun na ho. 

[pause] 

Kyunki jo insaan khud se jhoot bolna band kar deta hai, use harana is duniya ke liye namumkin ho jata hai.

[serious] Ab baat karte hain us rule ki jo aapki physical aur mental limits ko hamesha ke liye badal dega. Is niyam ko Goggins kehte hain: The 40% Rule. 

[measured] Jab aap running kar rahe hote hain, ya padh rahe hote hain, ya koi mushkil kaam kar rahe hote hain, toh ek lamha aata hai jab aapka dimaag kehta hai, "Bas, ab aur nahi ho sakta." Aapke muscle dukhne lagte hain, aapka sir bhari hone lagta hai, aur aapko lagta hai ki agar aapne abhi break nahi liya, toh aap gir padenge. 

[authoritative] Goggins kehte hain ki us thakkar ke mod par, aap sach mein sirf forty percent exhausted hote hain. Aapki body ke paas abhi bhi sixty percent energy bachi hoti hai. 

Lekin hamara dimaag ek survival machine hai. Wo hume dard se bachana chahta hai. Jaise hi use lagta hai ki dukh aur takleef badh rahi hai, wo ek signal bhejta hai ki "Ruk jao." Yeh dimaag ka ek automatic regulator hai, bilkul waise hi jaise gaadiyon mein speed limiter laga hota hai jo gaadi ko ek khaas speed se upar nahi jaane deta. 

Goggins ne is rule ko tab sikha jab wo Navy SEALs ki training ke 'Hell Week' se guzar rahe the. Hell Week ek aisi training hai jahan candidates ko lagbhag ek hafte tak sone nahi diya jata. Unhe barfile pani mein baithna padta hai, mitti mein daudna padta hai, aur lagatar physical torture se guzarana padta hai. Bahut se log pehle do din mein hi quit kar dete hain kyunki unka dimaag unhe kehta hai ki wo mar jayenge. 

Lekin jo log survive karte hain, wo is forty percent limit ko push karte hain. Jab aapka dimaag kahe ki aap thak gaye hain, tab aapko usse kehna hoga, "Abhi toh sirf shuruaat hui hai." 

[instructive] Isko apne normal life mein kaise apply karein? Jab aap padhne baithein aur do ghante baad aapka dimaag kahe ki ab aur nahi padha ja raha, tab ek ghanta aur padhiye. Jab aap workout kar rahe hain aur aapko lage ki ab aur ek rep nahi hoga, tab do reps aur lagaiye. Jab aap is temporary pain ke barrier ko todte hain, toh aapka dimaag dheere-dheere samajhne lagta hai ki uski limits sach nahi thin. Wo sirf ek illusion tha jo usne aapko safe rakhne ke liye banaya tha. 

Dard se bhagiye mat. Uska swagat kijiye. Kyunki dard ke us paar hi aapka asli potential chhupa hai.

[pause] 

Har baar jab aap us forty percent ke boundary ko cross karte hain, aap apne dimaag ke speed limiter ko thoda aur aage khiska dete hain.

[reflective] Ab ek aise concept par aate hain jo behad dilchasp hai aur thoda ajeeb bhi lag sakta hai. Is concept ka naam hai: Taking Souls. 

Goggins jab Navy SEAL training ke sabse mushkil daur se guzar rahe the, tab unke instructors unhe hamesha todne ki koshish karte the. Instructors chahte the ki Goggins aur unke saathi har maan lein. Lekin Goggins ne ek alag dhang se sochna shuru kiya. Unhone tay kiya ki wo sirf survive nahi karenge, balki wo apne instructors ki mental peace ko destroy karenge. 

Taking Souls ka matlab kisi ko nuksaan pahunchana nahi hai. Iska matlab hai ki jab halaat aapke khilaf hon, jab aapke boss, aapke competitors, ya aapki life ki situations aapko dabane ki koshish kar rahi hon, tab aap itni mehnat karein, itna discipline dikhayein ki samne wala aapka jazba dekh kar darr jaye. 

[authoritative] Imagine kijiye ek aisi situation jahan aapki company mein sabse mushkil target diya gaya hai. Sab log ro rahe hain, shikayat kar rahe hain. Lekin aap chupchap apna kaam karte hain. Aap sabse pehle aate hain, sabse baad mein jaate hain, aur bina kisi shikayat ke deliver karte hain. Jab aapke dushman ya aapke doubters aapko is tarah kaam karte dekhte hain, toh unka confidence hil jata hai. Wo sochne par majboor ho jaate hain ki, "Is insaan ko kaise todein? Ise toh dard hi nahi hota." 

Goggins kehte hain ki jab aap mushkil waqt mein muskura sakte hain, toh aap samne wale ki energy chheen lete hain. Aap unki soul ko take over kar lete hain. 

[instructive] Isko apne dimaag mein bitha lijiye. Jab bhi aapko koi aisi situation mile jahan lagta hai ki sab kuch aapke khilaf hai, wahan apni energy ko rone mein waste mat kijiye. Apne kaam ko apni dhaal banaiye. Itni shanti se aur itni be-rehmi se mehnat kijiye ki aapki success aapke un logon ke muh band kar de jo aapki haar ka intezar kar rahe the. 

Aapko kisi se argue karne ki zaroorat nahi hai. Aapka silent, relentless focus hi unki har chal ko be-asar kar dega.

[pause] 

Kyunki sabse badi jeet wo nahi hai jahan aap kisi ko hara dete hain, balki wo hai jahan aap unhe ye sochne par majboor kar dete hain ki aapse takrana unki sabse badi galti thi.

[serious] Agla lesson un sabhi ke liye hai jo mushkil waqt mein kamzor padne lagte hain. Is asset ko David Goggins kehte hain: The Cookie Jar. 

Hum sabki zindagi mein dukh aata hai. Ek aisa waqt aata hai jab hume lagta hai ki hum haar rahe hain. Sab kuch bikhar raha hota hai. Aise waqt mein hamara dimaag purani na-kamiyabi ko yaad karne lagta hai. Wo hume yaad dilata hai ki hum pehle bhi fail hue the, aur is baar bhi hum fail hi honge. 

[reflective] Is negative thoughts ke toofan ko rokne ke liye, Goggins ne ek mental technique banayi jise wo Cookie Jar kehte hain. 

Aapke kitchen mein cookie jar hota hai jisme se aap tab cookie nikalte hain jab aapka kuch meetha khane ka man karta hai. Goggins ka Cookie Jar ek mental box hai. Is box ke andar unhone apni zindagi ke un palon ko jama kiya hai jahan unhone mushkil se mushkil raste par chal kar jeet hasil ki thi. 

[measured] Jab wo ek ultra-marathon daud rahe the aur unke pairon ki haddiyan toot rahi thi, unke kidneys fail ho rahe the, aur wo chal bhi nahi pa rahe the, tab unhone apne mental Cookie Jar mein hath dala. Unhone khud ko yaad dilaya ki kaise unhone Navy SEAL ki Hell Week ko teen baar face kiya aur survive kiya. Unhone yaad dilaya ki kaise unhone ek sau tis kilo wazan kam kiya. Unhone khud se kaha, "Agar tumne wo sab kiya hai, toh tum is race ko bhi khatam kar sakte ho." 

[instructive] Aapko bhi apna Cookie Jar banana hoga. Isme sirf badi kamiyabiya nahi honi chahiye. Isme har wo choti jeet honi chahiye jahan aapne har nahi maani. Wo exam jiske liye aapne raat bhar jag kar padhai ki thi. Wo mushkil daur jab aapke paas paise nahi the lekin aapne survive kiya. Wo din jab aapka dil toota tha lekin aap phir se khade hue. 

Jab bhi aapki life mein andhera ho, jab aapko lage ki aap quit karne wale hain, apna dhyan us Cookie Jar par le jaiye. Un sabhi jeet ko yaad kijiye. Apne aap ko yaad dilaiye ki aap koi kamzor insaan nahi hain. Aapne pehle bhi dukh jhela hai, aur aap is baar bhi survive karenge. 

Apne past ko apni kamzori mat banne dijiye. Use apna fuel banaiye.

[pause] 

Kyunki jo insaan apni purani mushkilon se seekh kar unhe apni taqat bana leta hai, use koi bhi naya toofan hila nahi sakta.

[authoritative] Hamara aakhri aur sabse important lesson hai: Callousing the Mind. 

[measured] Hamare hath tab sakhth hote hain jab hum lagatar mehnat karte hain. Physical labor karne wale logon ke hathon ki skin moti aur sakhth ho jati hai, jise callus kehte hain. Us sakhth skin par phir thode bohot friction se dard nahi hota. 

[serious] Goggins kehte hain ki aapko apne dimaag ko bhi bilkul isi tarah callous karna hoga. 

Aaj ki duniya comfort ki aadi ho chuki hai. Hum chahte hain ki hume har cheez aasani se mil jaye. AC room ho, naram bister ho, fast internet ho, aur hum bina kisi takleef ke apna goal achieve kar lein. Lekin sachai iske bilkul ulti hai. Comfort ek aisi drug hai jo aapke dimaag ko slow aur kamzor bana deti hai. 

Dimaag ko callous karne ka ek hi tareeqa hai: Roz wo kaam kijiye jise karne se aapko darr lagta hai ya jise karne ka aapka mann nahi karta. 

[instructive] Agar aapko subah uthne se nafrat hai, toh roz subah paanch baje uthiye. Agar aapko cold shower se darr lagta hai, toh thande pani se nahaiye. Agar aapko public speaking se darr lagta hai, toh aage badhkar boliye. Jab aap lagatar un cheezon ko karte hain jo aapko uncomfortable karti hain, toh aapka dimaag dheere-dheere unse darna band kar deta hai. Wo sakhth ho jata hai. 

Goggins har roz daudte hain, chahe barish ho rahi ho, dhoop ho, ya unki tabiyat kharab ho. Wo isliye nahi daudte kyunki unhe daudna pasand hai. Wo isliye daudte hain kyunki unka mann kehta hai ki mat daudo. Aur unka dimaag unke mann ko harata hai. 

Apne dimaag ke sath ek deal kijiye. Jab bhi wo kahe ki "Kal karenge", aapko use kehna hai "Abhi karenge." Jab bhi wo kahe ki "Thoda aaram kar lete hain", aapko kehna hai "Thoda aur push karte hain." 

[pause] 

Isi tarah aapka dimaag ek sakhth chattan banega, jis par zindagi ki koi bhi musibat koi asar nahi daal payegi.

[reflective] Zindagi mein hum sab ek raste par hain. Kuch log raste ke kathin hone par peeche hat jate hain, aur kuch log raste ko hi badal dete hain. Lekin David Goggins hume sikhate hain ki rasta chahe kitna bhi pathrila kyun na ho, agar aapka dimaag disciplined hai, toh aap kisi bhi limits ko tod sakte hain. 

[serious] Yaad rakhiye, aapka sabse bada mukabla kisi aur se nahi hai. Wo aayine mein dikhne wale insaan se hai. Jab tak aap us insaan ko harane ki koshish nahi karenge, tab tak aapki zindagi mein koi badlav nahi aane wala. 

Apne comfort zone se bahar nikliye. Apne forty percent barrier ko push kijiye. Apne dimaag ko callous kijiye. Aur har us takleef ko apna fuel banaiye jo aapko todne ki koshish karti hai. 

[authoritative] Aapki kahani abhi khatam nahi hui hai. Yeh toh bas shuruaat hai. 

[pause] 

Goggins kehte hain ki jab tak aap saans le rahe hain, aapke paas fight karne ka ek aur mauka hai. Toh khade hoiye, aur apne dimaag ko bataiye ki asli boss kaun hai.
